title: Lean pilot: five models on the posted targets (2026-10-19)

design.question: Do shared lemmas make targets reachable that a model cannot prove alone?
design.compare: each model alone, and given the lemmas each target rests on
design.fixed: the 8 posted targets, 2 attempts each, up to 3 repairs, reasoning effort high, grind banned
design.measure: targets proved with lemmas but never alone

answer: Lemmas made targets reachable for 3 of 5 models. gpt-5.6-terra: X1; gemini-3.8-flash: X1, A5; deepseek-v4.1-flash: A3, B5, X2, A5 were proved with their lemmas but never alone.
caveats: claude-opus-5.5 and claude-sonnet-5.5 proved every target alone, so for them the lemmas save cost but are not needed.
Lemma statements are given, not found: this measures how much lemmas help, not whether labs would think of them.
A few attempts per cell: rates are rough.
